facts.en: Completed a BA in Communication at Fictional Institute D046 in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构院校 D046 完成传播学文学学士学位。

facts.en: Worked as a product support analyst at Fictional Software Cooperative D046 from 2021-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2021-02 至 2026-08 在虚构软件合作社 D046 担任产品支持分析师。

facts.en: Tagged customer feedback from support tickets and prepared a weekly issue digest for the product manager.
facts.zh: 为支持工单中的客户反馈添加标签，并为产品经理准备每周问题摘要。

facts.en: Used spreadsheet pivots and a shared issue tracker to separate feature requests from defects; engineers confirmed defect classifications.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格数据透视表和共享问题跟踪系统区分功能请求与缺陷；工程师确认缺陷分类。

facts.en: Co-designed a feedback taxonomy with a support lead and tested it on 160 tickets from 2025-04.
facts.zh: 与支持负责人共同设计反馈分类法，并在 2025-04 的 160 个工单上测试。

facts.en: In the same 160-ticket review, uncategorized tickets fell from 38 before retagging to 11 afterward; this measures backlog classification, not product satisfaction.
facts.zh: 在同一批 160 个工单复查中，未分类工单从重新标记前的 38 个降至之后的 11 个；该指标衡量积压分类情况，而非产品满意度。

facts.en: Assembled release-readiness checklists and collected approvals; the product manager made release decisions.
facts.zh: 整理发布准备清单并收集审批；产品经理作出发布决定。

facts.en: Coordinated a 2026-02 internal trial of revised release notes with 8 support colleagues and recorded their comments.
facts.zh: 在 2026-02 协调新版发布说明内部试用，8 名支持同事参与，并记录其意见。

facts.en: Drafted an automated feedback-routing proposal in 2026-05; no production automation was deployed.
facts.zh: 2026-05 起草反馈自动分流提案；未部署生产自动化。

facts.en: Read SQL query outputs provided by an analyst but did not independently author production SQL.
facts.zh: 阅读分析师提供的 SQL 查询输出，但未独立编写生产 SQL。

facts.en: At the 2025-11 launch peak, tracked 5 release checklists concurrently; the normal 2026-08 allocation was 2.
facts.zh: 在 2025-11 发布高峰期同时跟踪 5 份发布清单；2026-08 的常规分工为 2 份。

facts.en: Volunteered as a puzzle-club session organizer at Fictional Club V046 from 2024-03 to 2024-11 on weekends while employed.
facts.zh: 2024-03 至 2024-11 任职期间，周末在虚构社团 V046 志愿组织解谜活动。

facts.en: Built a personal spreadsheet catalog of board-game rules; it was not a customer product.
facts.zh: 建立个人桌游规则电子表格目录；该目录不是面向客户的产品。

facts.en: Wrote concise handover notes and maintained a glossary of product terminology for new support colleagues.
facts.zh: 撰写简明交接记录，并为新支持同事维护产品术语表。

facts.en: Did not own a product roadmap, pricing decisions or engineering headcount.
facts.zh: 未负责产品路线图、定价决策或工程人员编制。

facts.en: A draft self-review says launch delays fell by 20%, but no comparable launch baseline is attached.
facts.zh: 一份自评草稿称发布延误减少 20%，但未附可比发布基线。

facts.en: A portfolio heading says Product Operations Manager, while the appointment record says product support analyst.
facts.zh: 作品集标题写为产品运营经理，而聘任记录写为产品支持分析师。

facts.en: The confirmed reporting line was to the support lead, with no hiring or performance-review authority.
facts.zh: 经确认的汇报对象为支持负责人，无招聘或绩效评审权限。
